summary.result: In the historical data study, the A-S method and the SCE-UA method showed consistently good results regardless of objective function.
summary.background: Two global optimization methods, the SCE-UA method and the Annealing-simplex (A-S) method for calibrating a daily rainfall-runoff model, a Tank model, was compared with that of the Downhill Simplex method.
summary.method: The downhill simplex method was unable to escape from local optimum, the worst among the methods, and converged to the true values only when the initial guess was close to the true values.
